---
name: Documentation
about: A doc is wrong, missing, or out of date
title: '[DOCS] '
labels: documentation
---

**Which doc**
Path to the file (and section, if it's a long one).

**What's wrong**
Quote or describe the specific claim that's inaccurate, or name
what's missing. "Out of date" on its own isn't actionable — say
which part.

**Why it matters**
Who hits this and what they do wrong because of it. A stale README
that misleads a fresh clone is worse than one that says nothing.

**Done when**
The doc describes the code as it currently is. If the fix is
"delete the section," say so — removing a false claim is a valid
close.
